newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA REACHES ANOTHER MILESTONE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA REACHES ANOTHER MILESTONE.

text.p: Sanath Jayasuriya became the first batsman to score 1,000 test runs this year when he hit an unbeaten 85 for Sri Lanka in the second and final test against India on Tuesday.
Opener Jayasuriya, who made 340 in the drawn first test, helped to lift Sri Lanka's second innings from the overnight 77 for one to 163 for two -- a lead of 120 -- at lunch on the fourth day.
Jayasuriya dominated a second wicket stand of 80 with Roshan Mahanama, who was stumped by Nayan Mongia off Anil Kumble's leg spin 22 minutes before the interval.
Jayasuriya completed his half-century off 81 balls in 146 minutes hitting eight fours.
Aravinda de Silva, who joined him at the fall of Mahanama's wicket at 145, was undefeated on eight at lunch.
Vice-captain Kumble led India in the absence of captain Sachin Tendulkar, who was off the field nursing a thigh injury sustained while batting.
Kumble has taken both Sri Lanka wickets for 63.
